title: Let Z be an integral Noetherian scheme and G a coherent O_Z-module
statement: Let Z be an integral Noetherian scheme and G a coherent O_Z-module. There exist r ≥ 0 and a coherent ideal I on Z such that the coproduct of r copies of I is coherent and there is a monomorphism chi from that coproduct to G whose generic stalk is an isomorphism. This is the integral lattice construction, with no ambient closed immersion and no maximal-ideal annihilation hypothesis.

proof.text: On the integral Noetherian scheme Z the structure module and its finite direct sums are coherent. The generic local ring is a field and finite type of G makes its generic stalk finite dimensional. Choose r and a linear isomorphism from the generic stalk of the rank-r free module. Extend it over an open neighbourhood using coherent_stalk_map_extends and shrink using coherent_local_isomorphism.

proof.text: (Extending $\varphi$ over $Z$.) Let $T=Z\setminus U$, a closed subset of $Z$, and $\mathcal I_T\subseteq\mathcal O_Z$ the quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of the reduced induced structure on $T$ [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme](1) (Stacks 01J3): $\mathcal I_T(U')=\{f\in\mathcal O_Z(U'):f(t)=0\text{ in }\kappa(t)\ \forall t\in T\cap U'\}$. Then $\{z\in Z:(\mathcal I_T)_z\neq\mathcal O_{Z,z}\}=T$: for $z\in U$, $1\in\mathcal I_T(U)=\mathcal O_Z(U)$ (the condition is empty), so $(\mathcal I_T)_z=\mathcal O_{Z,z}$; for $z\in T$ every element of $(\mathcal I_T)_z$ is a germ $f_z$ with $f(z)=0$, i.e. $f_z\in\mathfrak m_z$ [def-weil-residue-field], so $(\mathcal I_T)_z\subseteq\mathfrak m_z$. Thus $U=Z\setminus V(\mathcal I_T)$ in the notation of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-homs-over-open] (Stacks 01YB). Apply that lemma on the Noetherian scheme $Z$ (step 1) to the quasi-coherent $\mathcal G$, the coherent $\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}$, the ideal $\mathcal I_T$ and $\psi=\varphi$: there are $n\ge0$ and an $\mathcal O_Z$-linear $\chi:\mathcal I_T^n\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}\to\mathcal G$ with $\chi|_U=\varphi$ under $(\mathcal I_T^n\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r})|_U=\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$. Put $\mathcal I=\mathcal I_T^n$ ($\mathcal I=\mathcal O_Z$ if $n=0$): a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-times-quasi-coherent-affine-sections](1), coherent since $Z$ is locally Noetherian (step 1) [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-kernel-cokernel-locnoeth](2). Moreover $\mathcal I\,\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}=\mathcal I^{\oplus r}$ as submodules of $\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}$: the tensor product commutes with finite direct sums and $\mathcal I\otimes_{\mathcal O_Z}\mathcal O_Z\cong\mathcal I$ (both hold for the presheaf tensor product and pass to sheafifications [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]), and under $\mathcal I\otimes\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}\cong\mathcal I^{\oplus r}$ the multiplication map is the componentwise inclusion $\mathcal I^{\oplus r}\to\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}$, whose image is $\mathcal I^{\oplus r}$. So $\chi:\mathcal I^{\oplus r}\to\mathcal G$, $\chi|_U=\varphi$; in particular $\chi|_V=\varphi|_V$ is an isomorphism and $\chi_\eta=\varphi_\eta$ is bijective.

proof.text: ($\chi$ is injective; the 'easy proof omitted' of the source.) Let $\mathcal K=\operatorname{Ker}\chi\subseteq\mathcal I^{\oplus r}\subseteq\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}$ (sectionwise kernel). It is coherent [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-kernel-cokernel-locnoeth](1), and $\mathcal K_\eta=\ker(\chi_\eta)=0$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact](2) (step 5). For $j=1,\dots,r$ let $p_j:\mathcal K\to\mathcal O_Z$ be the inclusion into $\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}$ followed by the $j$-th projection. Its image $\operatorname{Im}p_j$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal O_Z$ [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image](1),(2), with $(\operatorname{Im}p_j)_\eta=(p_j)_\eta(\mathcal K_\eta)=0$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact](4). As $Z$ is integral with generic point $\eta$, [lem-weil-pbc-integral-scheme-ideal-generic-stalk] ((a)$\Leftrightarrow$(c)) gives $\operatorname{Im}p_j=0$, so $p_j=0$ for every $j$. A section of $\mathcal K$ over an open $V'$ is a section of $\mathcal O_Z^{\oplus r}(V')=\mathcal O_Z(V')^{\oplus r}$ all of whose coordinates $p_j(s)$ vanish, hence $\mathcal K=0$: $\chi$ is injective on the sections over every open of $Z$. The source coproduct is coherent by finite sums of coherent modules, and the generic bijection is an isomorphism in ModuleCat. The argument includes r=0 and the unit ideal when the extension exponent is zero.

theorem coherent_integral_generic_ideal_map (Z : Scheme.{w}) [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsIntegral Z] (G : Z.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace G) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (I : Z.IdealSheafData),
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace I.toModules ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules) ∧
      ∃ (χ : (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules) ⟶ G), Mono χ ∧
        IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace (genericPoint Z)).map χ)
